description: This file contains helper functions and enums for testing the 'Cord' class in the Abseil C++ library, including size definitions, string conversions, and functions to create multi-segment Cord objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts TestCordSize enum to a string view.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size corresponding to a TestCordSize enum value.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of TestCordSize to an ostream.

methods.name: MakeFragmentedCord
methods.description: Creates a multi-segment Cord from a container of strings.
